note: Invented messages (no real people, schools or data) for the phone engine's tests and score. today is the day the message is read; expect lists what a parent would want proposed: type, then date (and endDate) or weekdays (0 = Monday), and words the title must contain. maybe: proposals that are fine but not required.

St Brigid's Primary - Newsletter

Bake sale. Friday 20 November after school in the hall. Please send in cakes in a named tub.

Non-uniform day. Friday 27 November: £1 donation for Children in Need.

Year 3 trip. The trip to the Science Centre is on Wednesday 2 December. Please return the consent form and pay £12 on ParentPay by Friday 27 November. Children need a packed lunch and a waterproof coat.

INSET day. School is closed on Monday 30 November.

[12/11/2026, 19:05] Lucy: Reminder PE is on Tuesdays and Thursdays from next week, kids need to come in their PE kit
[12/11/2026, 19:07] Sam: thanks!
[12/11/2026, 19:10] Lucy: Also Christmas jumper day is 11 December
Hi all! Maya is turning 7 and we'd love Ella to come to her party on Saturday 21 November, 2-4pm at Jump Zone. Please RSVP by Wednesday 18 November. Grip socks needed!
Swimming lessons move to Thursdays at 4:30pm from 3 December. Please bring goggles and a towel.

Dear Parents,
Flu vaccinations will take place on Tuesday 24 November. Please complete the online consent form by Friday 20 November.
Kind regards,
Mrs Smith
Half term is from 15-19 February. School reopens on Monday 22 February.
Reminder: Zara's dental check-up is on 25 November at 3:15pm.
Football club runs every Monday 3:30-4:30. Ballet is on Wednesdays.
Don't forget tomorrow is dress up as a book character day!
Next week we start our topic on space; please send in any space books.
Parents' evening appointments are on 1 and 2 December. Please book a slot on the school app by 26 November.
The last day of term is Friday 18 December, school finishes at 1:30pm.
Thanks everyone for coming to the assembly, the children were wonderful!

From: School Office <office@stbrigids.example>
Subject: Harvest festival
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026, 09:12

Our harvest festival is on Friday 27 November. Please send in tins or packets for the food bank.
School photos on 26/11. Sibling photos are before school at 8:30am.
PE is moved to Thursday this week because of the trip.
Please pay for school dinners by the end of the month.
Back to school on 6 January. Have a lovely break!
Nativity performances are on 9 and 10 December at 2pm. Children need a white T-shirt.

Christmas fair. Saturday 5 December, 11am to 2pm. We need volunteers for the tombola - please sign up on the sheet by the office.
Due to the heating repairs the school will be closed tomorrow. Please keep children at home.
Library books are changed every Friday, please make sure they're in book bags.
Please return the reading record by Friday.
Looking for a cleaner? Sparkle Clean has 20% off for school families. Call us any time!
